verdict.rationale: Capacities hosts an interactive reference at api.capacities.io/docs, generated from its published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, with authenticated try-it: users paste a Bearer token and send live requests from the dashboard. The successor portal advertises an interactive OpenAPI spec with TypeScript SDK samples for every endpoint. The 404 probes hit docs.capacities.io paths, not the api.capacities.io location of the spec, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the try-it requests and SDK samples work, and certainty about the reference's continuity, since the Beta API it documents is discontinued on September 1, 2026.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Interactive **reference** for all routes of the Capacities API. You can add your `cap-api-…` token in the **`Bearer Token`** field to make requests in this dashboard.
Interactive OpenAPI specification with every endpoint, schema, rate limit, and TypeScript SDK sample
If you need programmatic access to the API specification, you can download the OpenAPI 3.0 Specification
